title: 👩‍🏫 Professional Activities
text:
I have spent 7+ years building bioinformatics and data science workflows for clinical genomics, translational research, rare disease diagnosis, and pathogen surveillance. My work focuses on turning high-dimensional biomedical data into validated, reproducible, and decision-ready analytical systems.

Precision Scientific · 2021–2024
R&D | Middle bioinformatics engineer

Delivered MRD/HRD analytics for oncology studies, including regulatory-ready reports and work presented at SGO 2024.
Built platelet RNA-seq machine learning classifiers for differential diagnosis and biomarker discovery.
Productionized WDL/Cromwell cloud workflows for cancer genomics, reducing both runtime and cost by 50%.
Supported bioinformatics analysis for 5 cell and gene therapy products.



Details


Cancer auxiliary diagnosis enablement





Designed and productionized circulating tumor DNA-based Minimal Residual Disease (MRD) pipelines, covering study design, feature engineering, data analysis, and statistical reporting.


Delivered 4 clinical MRD studies and translated results into regulatory-ready reports; one outcome was presented at SGO 2024; co-authored 2 manuscripts, one published.


Analyzed whole-genome doubling (WGD) using low-pass whole-genome sequencing at around 1x coverage; standardized WGD definitions across four studies.


Built machine learning classifiers using platelet RNA-seq data to differentiate uterine sarcoma from leiomyoma, covering preprocessing, feature engineering, model evaluation, and biomarker detection.


Contributed to the national HRD reference standard project led by China’s National Institutes for Food and Drug Control.




Cell and gene therapy bioinformatics





Built analysis workflows for viral integration site mapping, AAV mutation detection, and CRISPR off-target assessment.


Supported product development and clinical trials for 5 cell and gene therapy products.




Bioinformatics workflow automation





Designed and productionized an integrated bioinformatics pipeline for cancer genomics using WDL and Cromwell; automated data processing and analysis workflows on Alibaba Cloud.


Developed modular WDL components for each pipeline step and validated output consistency.


Reduced pipeline runtime by 50% and cost by 50%.






GrandOmics Biosciences · 2019–2021
R&D | Middle bioinformatics engineer

Led development of China’s first targeted capture panel for third-generation sequencing in Duchenne muscular dystrophy diagnosis.
Built COVID-19 pathogen surveillance workflows for mutation tracking, lineage analysis, metagenomic detection, reporting, and visualization.
Benchmarked Nanopore, PacBio, and Illumina sequencing platforms for SNV, InDel, and structural variant detection.
Contributed to 4 rare disease studies and 2 peer-reviewed publications.



Details


Rare disease diagnosis




Led development of China’s first targeted capture panel for third-generation sequencing for Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD).


Improved sensitivity and accuracy for SV, SNV, and InDel detection compared with gold-standard approaches.


Automated the workflow, conducted 4 studies, and published 2 papers.




Pathogen surveillance and diagnosis




Built a Galaxy-based pathogen surveillance system during COVID-19 for mutation tracking, lineage analysis, and visualization.


Designed targeted amplification kits covering 30 respiratory pathogens.


Implemented end-to-end pipelines for identification, automated reporting, and interactive dashboards.


Delivered analysis tools accessible to wet-lab and clinical users.




Sequencing technology benchmarking




Conducted systematic benchmarking of basecalling and variant accuracy across sequencing platforms.


Compared Nanopore R9 and R10 chemistry performance.


Evaluated Nanopore, PacBio, and Illumina for SNV, InDel, and structural variant detection.






Geneis Beijing · 2017–2019
R&D | Bioinformatics engineer

Developed oncology biomarker assays and reproducible analysis workflows for lung and gastric cancer studies.
Implemented CNV, MSI, TMB, survival, RNA-seq, and methylation analyses for translational research.
Supported clinical interpretation through validated thresholds, visualizations, and biological summaries.
Co-authored early work on gene fusion detection and liquid-biopsy MSI analysis.



Details


Oncology assay and biomarker panel development




Developed a targeted amplification panel for lung cancer biomarkers; established CNV baseline thresholds using MAD-based normalization.


Implemented MSI profiling and visualization for genomic instability assessment.


Delivered reproducible analysis workflows for clinical reporting.




Multi-omics analysis in developmental biology




Performed differential expression and methylation analysis of mouse oocytes; identified key transcription factors and maturation-associated pathways.


Integrated transcriptomic and epigenomic signals to characterize developmental regulation.


Generated interpretable visualizations and biological summaries for collaborators.




Clinical cancer genomics and survival analysis




Conducted retrospective gastric cancer genomics analysis across SNV, InDel, CNV, MSI, and TMB.


Evaluated clinical correlations and survival outcomes using Kaplan-Meier analysis.


Supported biomarker interpretation for translational research studies.

title: Siwen Zhang
text:
AI & Machine Learning | Data Science | Bioinformatics
Hi there, welcome to my website.

My story
I am a data scientist with 7+ years of bioinformatics engineering experience, now focusing on applied AI and machine learning. My work has always lived where data is noisy, high-dimensional, and consequential: clinical genomics, translational research, diagnostics, and healthcare analytics. A concise summary of this work is available on the Bioinformatics page.
My move toward AI and machine learning comes from both long-standing curiosity and a clear professional direction: intelligent systems are becoming central to scientific discovery, healthcare, and real-world decision support. I am especially interested in building models that are robust, interpretable, and useful beyond benchmarks.
Since fall 2025, I have been pursuing an MSc in Computer Science at Leiden University, specializing in Data Science. Now in my second year, I am looking for an AI or machine learning internship where I can combine rigorous data science, software engineering, and domain-aware problem solving. My first-year average grade is 8.58 across 12 courses; the transcript is available on the Resumé page.


Key focus areas

Applied machine learning and predictive modeling
Large language models and agentic AI
Information retrieval, recommender systems, and text mining
Scientific and healthcare data science
Translational bioinformatics and computational genomics
